findings.description: The card is fetched and only the destination board is checked with _require_editor. Any user who is an editor on their own board can pass any card_id from a board they have no access to and move it into their board. That leaks and steals the card, and it also shifts positions of cards in the victim's column through detach. Nothing checks the actor's role on card.board_id.
findings.suggestion: Call self._require_editor(card.board_id, actor_id) before moving, in addition to the check on the target board.
findings.title: move_card does not check permission on the source board

findings.description: archive_card calls detach and then sets archived=True but leaves card.position unchanged. Archived cards are filtered out of cards_in_column, so any later restore would collide with live positions. Because the check order in move_card also reports errors differently, state may become inconsistent.
findings.suggestion: Reset the position on archive, or re-insert the card when it is restored, so positions stay contiguous.
findings.title: Archived card keeps its stale position, and unarchive/move behavior is inconsistent
